integrity: Every finite candidate is covered by a deterministic canonical rooted-tree multiset construction, unrooted center reduction, and exhaustive spanning-edge-set counting. Two independent component algorithms agree exactly. The scientific review is self-review only, with no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite enumeration for tree orders 4 through 10; no claim for higher orders or the general chromatic-symmetric tree conjecture. The literature comparison cannot eliminate all unpublished, unindexed, or supplementary computations.
title: The first strict connected-partition truncation gap occurs at ten vertices
